notes: Main disagreements: (1) phase on the IT Generative AI General Policy, mostly during-work (A) vs general (B); resolved as general because the policy governs IT use of AI tools and does not address coursework; elsewhere course-start vs before-course for syllabus statements, resolved as course-start for communicating expectations and before-course for sample language and option design; (2) modality on classification and recommendation sentences ('is considered plagiarism', 'may indicate', 'recommends that', 'the best way is'), resolved as informs for classifications and should for imperative recommendations and 'expected to'; (3) unit_stance, where A often coded restrict or prohibit and B neutral or require: resolved as neutral for compliance, security, reporting and detector-handling duties that neither allow nor limit AI use, restrict for bans with an authorization exception, prohibit for flat bans, permit for conditional permissions; (4) policy_type: P61 vs P56 (scope), P54 vs P84 (review date), P102 vs P78 (stay informed), P77 vs P50/P126 (comply with existing policy), P07 vs P126 (agentic AI oversight), P80 vs P98 (audit), P36 vs P45 (any-source integrity rule, P36 kept with fit note), P04 vs P09 (assignment-level rules), P26 vs P35 (drafts), P31 vs P26 (evidence and reflection), P110 vs P62 (Science policy as a model), UNCOVERED vs P56 (academic freedom, P56 with A's note kept as a fit note); (5) actor on definitions and framing sentences (all vs instructor/admin), resolved by who the sentence addresses; (6) splitting and alignment: B merged the 'reiterate expectations' and 'ChatGPT Edu does not shift policy' clauses (A's two units kept); B coded the seven-item risk list and the three pre-authorized data uses that A skipped, A coded the 'pre-authorized' sentence and several Senate passages B skipped; all only-A and only-B units were real statements and kept. Adjacent but distinct sentences on the same rule (Senate CET brainstorming advice, novice teaching opportunity) were counted as only-A and only-B and both kept. Stance matched on all four documents (delegates, delegates, permit, delegates). new_types empty on both sides. agree_* shares are over matched units; unit_stance agreement over matched units was 0.717.
